summary: The agent successfully completed a capacity/backlog planning task but went through unnecessary trial-and-error with the scheduling logic. The key insight from the trace is that the agent initially overcomplicated the decision logic by adding a 'check if chosen days would create backlog' clause, then correctly reverted to following the deterministic policy exactly as specified. The task also involved specific data extraction from an Excel file with a non-standard layout (row-based labels, column-based weeks). This update adds a reference document for Excel data extraction patterns and updates the SKILL.md with clearer guidance on following the policy exactly without adding 'smart' checks, plus better documentation of the calc_start vs reported_start distinction that confused the agent.
